title: A Novel Computational and Analytical Framework for 2D Quasiperiodic Helmholtz Eigenvalue Problems via the Projection Method
summary: In this paper, we propose a spectral framework that embeds 1D and 2D quasiperiodic Helmholtz eigenvalue problems into higher-dimensional (2D and 4D) periodic spaces via the projection method \cite{jiang2014numerical, jiang2024numerical}. To effectively map the elevated high-dimensional states back to the original physical space, we establish a novel validation framework based on the weighted expectation of pointwise Rayleigh quotients.
